CustomField.description: What kind of hours entry this is. Relinquished hours are given up by a notarized letter and are entered as a negative number. Activity is hours credited for a field trip, workshop, show or community service. Termination records that a student or instructor stopped training (End Date is the last day attended); it carries no hours. Continuing Education is a licensee's attendance at a CE seminar, not student hours. Stop codes ignore Continuing Education and Termination entries.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose Relinquished for hours given up by notarized letter, and enter them as a negative number. Choose Continuing Education for a licensee's CE seminar attendance.
CustomField.label: Entry Type
